MOCKUP Today · L0 · L1 · L2 Green: the relations AWS already offers.

Still looked up elsewhere

RelationMethodBody
generatePOSTdescription, tags
updatePATCHpatchOperations
deleteDELETEnone

Three more docs pages, read by a developer and coded into a client. That is the gap HEART closes, one rung at a time.
say: AWS's real sample response, written as YAML, all of it but the certificate's PEM body. The relations are typed and per item: delete and update sit on the certificate, generate on the list. What a client can't learn from it: the method, the fields, the limits. Those are on three other docs pages, linked by the curie. The next four slides are a mockup: the same resources as HEART would answer, at each rung.
